I can edit your writing in American English while preserving your meaning, voice, and formatting. For the least invasive edit, use `Proofread: [your text]`.

For shorter text, try:

- `Trim the fat: [your text]` — about 5–10% shorter.
- `Less wordy: [your text]` — about 30% shorter.
- `More concise: [your text]` — about 40% shorter.
- `More succinct: [your text]` — about 50–60% shorter.

I can also explain English usage or use a requested style, such as casual, professional, or academic. Send your text and any editing directions.
